threejs-rag.description: Three.js knowledge base: hybrid search (dense + BM25, RRF-fused) over the pinned r186 API reference, the r186 source tree with JSDoc, addon sources, cookbook, rules and anti-patterns, plus whatever Three.js project is indexed as source=project.

assets.description: Local asset pipeline driven by the ComfyUI sidecar on 127.0.0.1:8188: text-to-image, background removal, image-to-3D (economy TripoSplat splat/mesh, high-quality Pixal3D/TRELLIS.2 mesh), plus listing and previewing what was produced. Every artefact is named from the request slug, never from a ComfyUI counter. `asset_generate_pack` runs a whole asset list in one serialised pass: the llama-server on :8080 is stopped so ComfyUI gets the whole 8 GB card, then restarted once the finished files are in the project. The 7200 s timeout is for that call - a pack of several 3D models is legitimately a long silence.
